title.en: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)
title.hi: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)

definition.en: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was a multilateral treaty designed to promote international trade by reducing or eliminating trade barriers such as tariffs and quotas.
definition.hi: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was a multilateral treaty designed to promote international trade by reducing or eliminating trade barriers such as tariffs and quotas.

importanceInUpsc.en: GATT is foundational for understanding the evolution of the global trading system and the eventual establishment of the World Trade Organization (WTO). For UPSC GS-3, it provides the necessary context for analyzing India's trade policy, liberalization efforts, and participation in international economic forums.
importanceInUpsc.hi: GATT is foundational for understanding the evolution of the global trading system and the eventual establishment of the World Trade Organization (WTO). learningOutcomes.en: Understand the historical context and objectives of GATT in the global economy.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of GATT principles on India's trade liberalization and economic integration.
